label: CI/CD
info:
Keeps this gateway's flows in sync with the fleet's GitHub repo.

Checks every hour; runs 24 h after the last successful run (not at boot).
A failed run is retried every hour until one succeeds. "Run now" runs immediately
(also via the Admin API: POST /node-red/inject/4b8d2f6a1c3e5d70).

Each run:
1. Log in to ThingsBoard, find the asset "github token" by name, read its server attributes:
   github_repo, github_branch, github_token, nr_username, nr_password (kept in memory only)
2. Log in to the local Node-RED Admin API
3. Download every .json file in the repo root (one message per file, joined into msg.flows)
4. Read the deployed flows (GET /flows) and match each GitHub flow by NAME:
   missing -> install (POST /flow), different -> update (PUT /flow/:id), same -> skip,
   several flows with the same name -> skip + error
5. ci-cd.json updates this updater tab itself, always last

The ThingsBoard login comes from the "Fleet config" flow (fleet-config.json), not from this flow.
